from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the provided collection, with its title and citations to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The paper's title")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that this paper cites")
    is_cited_by_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that cite this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
